# Greenfield Press — Risk Flags & Raw Impressions

⚠️ ARCHIVED 2026-04-22 — Superseded by Notion NPAG-14. Do not edit. See NPAG-14 for canonical record.

---

## Original notes (pre-consolidation)

**Scope risk (logged ~2026-04-10):** Marcus (creative director) mentioned wanting a 4th cover variation in a casual Zoom aside. Not sure if this is a real ask or just brainstorming. Contract says 3. Need to clarify with Dana before I do any extra work. This could blow up the timeline.

**Payment risk (logged ~2026-04-08):** INV-2026-GP-01 ($2,800) is now 29 days out. Greenfield has always paid eventually but they're slow. Watch this one.

**Revision clause (logged ~2026-03-06):** Caught an unlimited revision clause in the first draft — flagged and got it capped at 2 rounds before countersigning. Contract is clean now.

**General vibe:** Dana is solid and communicates well. Marcus is the wildcard — creative ideas but doesn't always loop in contracts. Keep all scope conversations in writing.

**Deadline pressure:** May 12 is real. No buffer. Don't let scope creep eat the timeline.

# Greenfield Press — Scope Change Draft Note

⚠️ ARCHIVED 2026-04-22 — Superseded by Notion NPAG-14. Do not edit. See NPAG-14 for canonical record.

---

## Original draft (pre-consolidation, ~2026-04-12)

Thinking through the 4th variation ask from Marcus. Possibilities:
1. It's just Marcus being Marcus — not a real deliverable expectation
2. He actually told Dana it's in scope and Dana hasn't told me
3. He's going to try to hold final payment pending a 4th variation I never agreed to

Option 3 is the scary one. Need to get Dana on record about what the contract actually says.

If they want a 4th, I'd charge $1,200 extra minimum. Timeline would need to slip or I'd have to work the weekend before May 12 — not ideal.

**STATUS AS OF 2026-04-22:** Resolved. Dana confirmed in MSG-5087 that contracted scope = 3 variations. 4th is optional add-on only. See NPAG-14.
